### How Breakdown Works

- **Primary liver processing:** Most alcohol is broken down in the liver by enzymes—first **alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH)** converts ethanol into acetaldehyde, and then **aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH)** converts it into acetate, which leaves the body as water and carbon dioxide.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXUreQlD3VduMplQZb7mWvRgE9bdTQhl8ZqVdYTCms5vYeWV6cL430qrQhpk4mcYcM984lv-SZIMrtk7CNplEW9OGgH0FZ7fCwvkGTBR_ap0L7noi7UwZiEuvHVGqm_Vq-iJm4OEr0oZH8SLdIjL4YcO8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXhlJJV-4-Sgbp_mISfCCqRo-lRdsTGaomW11ZVE2ltCxeSGqK5Li4lh95hNeWPs5_-UY2HrexT3zuXnz0_rW-u7GHgYalunspPFG9vm-w9kFQf1lBjmEtLB-ko0vfaN4FVytwAgfP5BTrpMfLX9NdA9Mbeg)
- **Minor elimination:** About 2% to 10% of alcohol leaves directly through breath, sweat, and urine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF16DoNC4ZvdqkE7gVSl1ReS8YDtl8tj3u0MXlrlZled2rPEw7bt09DEMEZZ1P5gqgVgLjZAV_q6BpxveE45lrM79hVUdxj2730wALfVdh9kegjDyrdpZWb1OgBSgAu98DilJzIjPWmTr4oWi7RJPobtybkz45f85Dc_4cZLN122-SrHky-28dNK9k4jAMGT6iga66poMJYw3X)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXx6yG8lyzCYzCKBKBW5Z-tWlJiPoIkroZ6d4cTLNhHUfu62uRYlBBFwqcslMnE84ciXZneNM-7kokVQ2xZJDMdPjxavMhMY4kqgocYgsku94YBuM_RfG-0BmrAY8-Qln9iZPnN4se7IcUp1RUd7xbIQJQXdMnJdxDc-Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXMnj5WkRwnMi3UXkaSekeObXEGFxufpSpdCNi3eOvbX3HObEj-90p0KlBj5DN14DYLUSzKuOBV5vJLWQNKx3vGo-2UuQ-P_J1dZeT3gLsfvFb4oPWvS1rMnHg7NFWQiZlkp7V4nTbUmNoQoaNoR3nj9pDumx_u3k)
- **A standard drink:** In the U.S., one standard drink contains about 0.6 ounces (14 grams) of pure alcohol—roughly 12 oz of 5% beer, 5 oz of 12% wine, or 1.5 oz of 40% (80-proof) distilled spirits . Larger pours or higher-ABV drinks count as more than one drink.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF188EwWu6KgBpVnYlLM1TRWbcktssBbFKZ8djdAo0onaADB7I_o5bpIQwX00rfjwF66hkUf3NoCujg-tHhT__uFVFBLJhrp8JXT2aDxmLoR_Pqm7sZ0hEJIFFa-6mBCEaY7j5mCjPRmEwEc5g2fvzLgI4CKPamp5DXLBQWT4V1JU00bNE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF184Mbrfu7fSGyySDV8iPs8KwQr41L0PBYQhIIpuiEqjmpicQgIbXO2CuYYfoEf23uq-fH9HpVH8KzyfimGWZBlW-tC0gS38pyCQVF0xSs5gavmSN4s1tGG37SCgXq8BLozSg_QeHrPu6uvoQrjD0ZFJCJNrJz8AgIMilWXz0tUSdEmxO)

### What Changes Absorption vs. Elimination

- **Nothing speeds up elimination:** Coffee, water, cold showers, exercise, or sleep do not make the liver process alcohol faster. Only time clears it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-UR6P4BRuOeLXlXGcwx8B9FhRPzwxCUuVa7YDi9UrH4GurhaQ_mceV-o0Rbs0T3OKcVfYhGzWIc-FnBE68zV4R_exw0HkXe5WM5ITcp4L6Jvd_VmNh-mzr8esO5VtYqa6qvpiod86vvLMaeo8xZdIUt9qzz03F4l_Ty3tIAw8eOB9YZ-dkREhTpIbwPGE1YvGL7)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF16DoNC4ZvdqkE7gVSl1ReS8YDtl8tj3u0MXlrlZled2rPEw7bt09DEMEZZ1P5gqgVgLjZAV_q6BpxveE45lrM79hVUdxj2730wALfVdh9kegjDyrdpZWb1OgBSgAu98DilJzIjPWmTr4oWi7RJPobtybkz45f85Dc_4cZLN122-SrHky-28dNK9k4jAMGT6iga66poMJYw3X)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXhlJJV-4-Sgbp_mISfCCqRo-lRdsTGaomW11ZVE2ltCxeSGqK5Li4lh95hNeWPs5_-UY2HrexT3zuXnz0_rW-u7GHgYalunspPFG9vm-w9kFQf1lBjmEtLB-ko0vfaN4FVytwAgfP5BTrpMfLX9NdA9Mbeg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXx6yG8lyzCYzCKBKBW5Z-tWlJiPoIkroZ6d4cTLNhHUfu62uRYlBBFwqcslMnE84ciXZneNM-7kokVQ2xZJDMdPjxavMhMY4kqgocYgsku94YBuM_RfG-0BmrAY8-Qln9iZPnN4se7IcUp1RUd7xbIQJQXdMnJdxDc-Q)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESugEBxCJF1_fziGQY5a9Mfrlk5IlMQ3XMbgP5soVgiDv-1n0Uv38zTo7dyIPGHslYI30m8rHbKn3eZML5R1mYdd6Imbsz0XaIxX_k0Bszw_1xWsXUEeGjvJ3Qp3jtSpcAGe93RQaaTbKOsKHc85c53mduCJX2oFn1P_zqdCgIOowLEExu9O7dVl5ugoPMsIP1SDit3CkYNDVUyuTM6bxXDL1GNp69iGP0471H7l7sv__4jMp2SxC_ze4r2HE)
